targets.title: Mind your language: The effects of linguistic ostracism on interpersonal work behaviors.
targets.evidence_quote: To replicate Fiset and Bhave’s (2021) results and assess the robustness of our findings, we conducted supplemental analyses for the two other performance dimensions, interpersonal deviance behaviors and interpersonal citizenship behaviors.
targets.outcome_quote: We constructively replicate and extend their work in several ways. First, we replicate prior effects on interpersonal citizenship and deviance and extend their work to focus on a third dimension of job performance: task performance.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly state that the prior effects replicate. Dotan-Eliaz et al. supplied the experimental protocol rather than the focal finding retested.

reasoning: New participants retest the published linguistic-ostracism findings. Study 1 tests a task-performance extension; Study 2 retests the target.
